recommendations.title: Transition from Engagement to Lead-Objective Campaign
recommendations.detail: The current active campaign is set to Engagement, but historical data shows that the '📁 2026 | Leads | Multi Models | JULY' campaign using the OUTCOME_LEADS objective was far more effective, yielding a 3.43% CTR and 11 high-intent messages at ₱83.81 each. Relaunch or pivot the active budget to a Leads-optimized campaign featuring 'Multi Models' to capture higher-intent car buyers.

recommendations.title: Stabilize and Increase Daily Budget Pacing
recommendations.detail: The account has experienced frequent gaps with ₱0 spend over the last 30 days (only ₱2,842.75 spent overall). Consistently run the campaigns without pausing to stabilize the delivery algorithm. Raise the daily budget from ₱250.00 to ₱500.00 to gather enough statistical significance and exit the learning phase.

recommendations.title: Deploy Multi-Model Carousel Creatives
recommendations.detail: Leverage the success of the historical 'Multi Models' campaign by deploying carousel ads showcasing different vehicle categories (SUVs, sedans, pickups) with pricing or low-downpayment options, driving prospects directly to Messenger.
